name: Pzem6L24 → Reset Energy
description: This action resets the energy counters on the device with the given ID when executed.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the PZEM-6L24 component to reset.

config_entries.label: Phase
config_entries.description: Which energy counters to reset. One of `all` (phases A, B, C and the combined total), `a`, `b`, `c` or `combined`. Defaults to `all`.
